public_rationale: The claim concerns what Musk said in one session at the Future Investment Initiative in Riyadh on 29 October 2024. A Fortune report published on 30 October 2024 (e1) confirms that he spoke at the summit. It reports that he said AI was going to get 10 times better this year, and that it could do anything a human can do within a year or two. The report does not quote the 10,000x extrapolation. It also does not say whether he raised data, compute or LLM limits. The packet has no full transcript or recording of the session, which the contract requires. The evidence neither confirms nor contradicts Marcus's statement that Musk did not consider those bottlenecks.
limitations: The only item is one news report. It covers parts of Musk's remarks, not the full session.
The packet has no transcript or recording of the session.
The evidence does not show the 10,000x extrapolation itself or the remarks around it.
It is unclear whether 'never considering' refers to that sentence, the whole session, or Musk's views in general. Remarks made at other events are not in the packet.
